case.believed: Changing the locale changes startOf('week') automatically, while minimalDays is only descriptive metadata and cannot change localWeekYear.
contract: assert en-US reports firstDay 7 and minimalDays 1 while en-GB reports firstDay 1 and minimalDays 4
assert 2021-01-01 is local week 1 of 2021 in en-US but local week 53 of 2020 in en-GB, while ISO weekNumber/weekYear remain 53/2020 in both
assert startOf('week') remains ISO Monday unless useLocaleWeeks is true, which selects Sunday for en-US and Monday for en-GB
assert Settings.defaultWeekSettings overrides firstDay and minimalDays even for explicitly supplied locales and validates that minimalDays is between 1 and 7
assert changing minimalDays from 1 to 4 with the same Sunday firstDay changes the boundary date from 2021 week 1 to 2020 week 53 without changing its local week start
assert changing the global week settings affects newly created DateTimes but does not mutate an existing DateTime's captured local week values
case.goal: Calculate Luxon 3.6.1 locale weeks knowing how minimalDays differs from ISO weeks and startOf('week')
